IVX HOLDINGS — FINAL REMAINING ISSUES EXECUTION MAP
FIX ONE ISSUE AT A TIME — DO NOT START THE NEXT UNTIL THE CURRENT ISSUE IS VERIFIED

CURRENT RULE

Do not create new features.
Do not repeat completed work.
Do not combine multiple unresolved issues into one long narrative.
Do not label a dependency as a software defect.
Do not report COMPLETE while any issue is running, blocked, failed, partial, or not tested.

For every issue:

1. Confirm the current status.
2. Reproduce or verify the blocker.
3. Identify the exact root cause.
4. Fix only that root cause.
5. Add or update tests.
6. Commit the change.
7. Trigger the required build or deployment.
8. Wait for the final result.
9. Verify the actual feature or artifact.
10. Return evidence.
11. Stop before starting the next issue.

Allowed statuses:

- VERIFIED
- RUNNING
- PARTIAL
- BLOCKED
- FAILED
- NOT TESTED

==================================================
ISSUE 1 — ANDROID BUILD COMPLETION
==================================================

CURRENT STATUS: RUNNING

This is the first priority because APK distribution, device QA, 26 production flows, and some performance tests depend on it.

Required actions:

1. Open the latest Android build:
   Run ID: use the latest current run only.
2. Confirm the exact GitHub commit.
3. Wait for the build to finish.
4. If it fails:
   - capture the exact failed step
   - capture the first real error
   - identify the exact file
   - fix only that defect
   - commit
   - trigger a new build
5. Repeat until the build finishes successfully.

Verify:

- Expo config
- Prebuild
- Dependency install
- Gradle
- Kotlin
- Android manifest
- Resource merge
- JavaScript bundle
- Signing
- Artifact creation

Return:

ANDROID RUN ID:
ANDROID BUILD ID:
GITHUB COMMIT:
BUILD STATUS:
FAILED STEP:
ROOT CAUSE:
FILES CHANGED:
FINAL EXIT CODE:
APK OR AAB:
ARTIFACT HASH:
BUILD START:
BUILD FINISH:

Acceptance:

ANDROID BUILD STATUS: FINISHED
FAILED STEPS: 0
ANDROID ARTIFACT: PRESENT

STOP AFTER ISSUE 1.

==================================================
ISSUE 2 — ANDROID ARTIFACT AND APK DISTRIBUTION
==================================================

Start only after Issue 1 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: BLOCKED BY ANDROID BUILD

Required actions:

1. Download the exact artifact from the successful Android build.
2. Verify it matches the successful commit.
3. Determine whether the artifact is:
   - APK
   - AAB
4. If only AAB exists and a test APK is required, generate an approved internal APK build.
5. Publish the artifact through an owner-controlled download path.
6. Do not present an old artifact as the current build.

Return:

APK BUILD ID:
APK VERSION:
VERSION CODE:
APPLICATION ID:
COMMIT SHA:
APK HASH:
FILE SIZE:
ARTIFACT REFERENCE:
CURRENT BUILD:
OLD APK REMOVED OR ARCHIVED:

Acceptance:

APK AVAILABLE: true
APK MATCHES CURRENT COMMIT: true
STALE APK PRESENTED: false

STOP AFTER ISSUE 2.

==================================================
ISSUE 3 — ANDROID INSTALLATION AND LAUNCH QA
==================================================

Start only after Issue 2 is VERIFIED.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT TESTED

Use an Android emulator, cloud device, or owner device.

Required tests:

- Fresh install
- App launch
- Splash screen
- Owner login
- Session restore
- Logout and login
- App background/resume
- App restart
- No immediate crash
- Correct API environment
- Correct Supabase project
- Correct app version
- No Rork runtime call

Return:

DEVICE:
ANDROID VERSION:
APK HASH:
INSTALL RESULT:
LAUNCH RESULT:
CRASHES:
TRACE IDS:
SCREENSHOTS:
SCREEN RECORDING:

Acceptance:

INSTALL RESULT: PASS
LAUNCH RESULT: PASS
CRASHES: 0

STOP AFTER ISSUE 3.

==================================================
ISSUE 4 — IOS BUILD COMPLETION
==================================================

Start after Issue 1 is complete. It may run in parallel only if Issue 1 is already stable.

CURRENT STATUS: RUNNING

Required actions:

1. Open the latest iOS run only.
2. Confirm the exact commit.
3. Wait for completion.
4. If it fails:
   - capture the exact failed step
   - capture the first real error
   - identify the exact file
   - fix only that defect
   - commit
   - trigger a new build
5. Repeat until finished.

Verify:

- Expo config
- iOS prebuild
- CocoaPods
- Xcode compile
- Config plugins
- Signing or simulator packaging
- Artifact creation

Return:

IOS BUILD ID:
GITHUB COMMIT:

STOP AFTER ISSUE 4.

==================================================
ISSUE 5 — IOS AUTOMATED QA
==================================================

Start only after Issue 4 is VERIFIED.

Use one available path:

1. EAS Workflows + Maestro
2. BrowserStack real iPhone
3. Mac runner + Xcode Simulator

Required flows:

- Install
- Launch
- Owner login
- Open chat
- Latest message visible
- No initial jump
- Keyboard

- Background/resume
- Restart
- No crash

Owner physical iPhone QA may remain pending, but automated iOS QA must be completed.

STOP AFTER ISSUE 5.

==================================================
ISSUE 6 — DATABASE TRUTH RECONCILIATION
==================================================

CURRENT STATUS: PARTIAL

Do not rely only on API counts.

Audit the real database source for:

- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- Waitlist
- Deals
- Videos
- Messages
- Notifications
- Enterprises

- Autonomous runs
- Executive reports
- Evidence records

Rules:

- SEC-discovered records are not active investors or buyers unless classified.
- Test records are excluded from production totals.
- Deleted and archived records are treated consistently.
- Every dashboard number must open the underlying records.
- No fake business totals.

Required final values:

UNEXPLAINED COUNT MISMATCHES: 0
TEST RECORDS IN BUSINESS TOTALS: 0
FAKE INVESTOR TOTALS: 0
FAKE BUYER TOTALS: 0

STOP AFTER ISSUE 6.

==================================================
ISSUE 7 — TRANSIENT POSTGRES TIMEOUT VERIFICATION
==================================================

CURRENT STATUS: REPORTED VERIFIED, REQUIRES FINAL PROOF

Audit the runs that previously failed.

Required:

- Exact query category
- Exact timeout
- Retry count
- Backoff
- Final result
- Duplicate prevention
- Trace ID
- Query plan
- Index used

Run controlled tests:

- Delayed write

- Retry exhausted
- Worker restart during retry
- Database reconnect

STOP AFTER ISSUE 7.

==================================================
ISSUE 9 — CHAT DEVICE QA
==================================================

Start only after Issue 3.

Owner will perform the final physical-phone confirmation, but Rork must prepare and ingest the evidence.

Required test:

- Force-close app
- Reopen
- Open chat
- Latest conversation opens
- Newest message immediately visible
- No initial jump
- No immediate yellow arrow
- Send
- Receive
- Scroll older history
- Load older page
- Return to latest
- Keyboard
- App restart
- Reopen chat

Rork responsibilities:

- Generate QA checklist
- Generate trace ID
- Capture diagnostics
- Receive screen recording
- Compare evidence to exact commit
- Fix only failed criteria
- Return honest verdict

Acceptance:

LATEST MESSAGE IMMEDIATELY VISIBLE: true
VISIBLE INITIAL JUMP: false
YELLOW ARROW ON INITIAL OPEN: false
DUPLICATE MESSAGES: 0
PAGINATION POSITION STABLE: true
KEYBOARD QA: PASS
APP RESTART QA: PASS

STOP AFTER ISSUE 9.

==================================================
ISSUE 10 — PERFORMANCE AND LOAD QA
==================================================

Start after builds and core flows are stable.

CURRENT STATUS: NOT RUN

Run:

- 10 concurrent users
- 25 concurrent users
- 50 concurrent users
- 100 concurrent users
- 500 queued autonomous tasks
- 1,000 historical runs
- 1,000-message chat
- 10,000 stored messages
- Backend restart
- Worker restart
- Scheduler restart
- Database slowdown
- AI-provider slowdown
- Network interruption

Measure:

- API p50/p95/p99 latency
- Chat initial load
- Dashboard load
- Queue latency
- Error rate
- Retry rate
- Duplicate rate
- Memory
- CPU
- Recovery time

Required:

DUPLICATE MUTATIONS: 0

STOP AFTER ISSUE 10.

==================================================

==================================================

CURRENT STATUS: REPORTED VERIFIED

Recheck after all current deployments.

Verify:

- Next run exists

- Report has non-empty content
- Report stored permanently
- Report delivered to IVX Chat
- Report appears in dashboard

- Restart survival

==================================================

Only report:

when:

[ ] Android artifact available

[ ] iOS build finished

Otherwise use:

==================================================

==================================================
